description: React component for the RHS header in Mattermost, managing UI interactions such as back navigation, thread follow toggling, popout window, and sidebar expand/collapse.

classes.name: RhsHeaderPost
classes.description: React component for the RHS header, handling UI controls and interactions for thread view.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Handles back navigation based on previous RHS state.

methods.name: handleJumpClick
methods.description: Handles jump to the post in the main view, collapsing sidebar if on mobile.

methods.name: handleFollowChange
methods.description: Toggles follow/unfollow state for the thread.

methods.name: popout
methods.description: Opens the thread in a popout window.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the header UI including buttons for back, follow, popout, expand/collapse sidebar, and close.
